ns2:section.sectionText: Grounded Theory: Training in grounded theory methodology with an emphasis on working with data from in-depth individual and group interviews. Topics include the historical and epistemological context of grounded theory, interviewing technigues, coding strategies, evaluation criteria, data management using NVivo software, and comparison to other qualitative strategies. Seats may be reserved by class level or major. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://hcd.uiuc.edu/prospective/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
